scientific_integrity: The characterization is proved directly for every finite graph in scope; the supplied exhaustive script checks 66 bounded part-size profiles only. The scalar chromatic maximum and the underlying class-size inequality are attributed to prior published work. Historical priority of the new enumerator is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: The classification covers connected finite simple complete multipartite graphs with at least two positive-sized parts and largest part size at least three. It counts surjective optimal partial sub-quorum colourings on fixed labelled vertices, not suboptimal palettes or colourings modulo graph automorphisms. Independent expert validation has not occurred.
title: Optimal sub-quorum colourings of complete multipartite graphs: a sharp rigidity threshold
